item.cobblemon.dubious_disc.tooltip: Evolves Porygon2 into Porygon-Z and Porygon into Beta Porygon2 when held while trading
cobblemon.species.slowbro.desc: Slowbro's tail has a Turbann firmly attached with a bite. As a result, the tail can't be used for fishing anymore. This causes Slowbro to grudgingly swim and catch prey instead.
cobblemon.species.slowbro-galar.desc: A Turbann bite set off a chemical reaction with the spices inside Slowbro's body, causing Slowbro to become a Poison-type Pokémon.
cobblemon.species.slowking.desc: Slowking undertakes research every day in an effort to solve the mysteries of the world. However, this Pokémon apparently forgets everything it has learned if the Turbann on its head comes off.
cobblemon.species.slowking-galar.desc: A combination of toxins and the shock of evolving has increased Turbann intelligence to the point that Turbann now controls Slowking.
